plComponentCosting.title: Component costing
plComponentCosting.subtitle: What one moulded piece costs: granules, masterbatch, packing and mould wear

how.title: How a piece is costed
how.formula: Cost per piece = granules + masterbatch + packing + mould wear

granule.title: Granules
granule.body: Shot weight per piece (part + runner ÷ cavities), less the masterbatch share, at the granule's average stock cost.

masterbatch.title: Masterbatch
masterbatch.body: The masterbatch % of the shot weight per piece at its average stock cost.

packing.title: Packing
packing.body: Packing cost per piece set on the spec.

mould.title: Mould wear
mould.body: From Mould costing: (cost + upkeep) ÷ life in shots ÷ cavities.
